topic: Data request parameters for dwell time
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the required granularity for data requests, specifically regarding dwell time. [p1] provided two sets of duration parameters: a standard hourly granulation and an alternative set designed for 5-minute dwell tracking.

Standard durations were listed as `[0,300],[301,600],...` (up to 86400).
The proposed 5-minute dwell durations were provided by [me] as a list of specific time brackets: `[[0,300],[301,600],[601,900],[901,1200],[1201,1500],[1801,2100],[2101,2400],[2401,2700],[2701,3000],[3001,3300],[3301,3600]]`.

[p1] confirmed that for now, the focus should remain on existing data structures rather than implementing the 5-minute dwell tracking.
decisions: The immediate focus remains on utilizing current data parameters.
